title: 20160616_night.15.wav
author: dobroide
changes: Real recording of a summer night in a pine forest near Aznalcázar, Spain: crickets trilling while a flying firefly beetle (Lampyridae) buzzes past the microphone. Trimmed to 3.90–6.60 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. The 70 Hz high-pass removes measured low-frequency rumble.
